name: Ordersmith – Orders & Stock Sync for TikTok Shop
author: sysridge

sections.description:
Selling on TikTok Shop and your own WooCommerce store? Ordersmith connects the two, so you stop copying orders by hand and stop selling the same item twice.

What it does

  • Orders in, instantly. New TikTok Shop orders appear in WooCommerce within seconds, with items, shipping fee and discounts. Status changes (on hold, awaiting shipment, delivered, cancelled) follow automatically, and completed TikTok refunds and returns are recorded as WooCommerce refunds (returned items go back into stock).
  • Ship from WooCommerce. For orders shipped with a TikTok Shop label, arrange drop-off or pickup and print the label from the order screen. If you use your own courier, enter the carrier and tracking number and Ordersmith sends them to TikTok Shop.
  • Stock stays matched. Every stock change in WooCommerce (sales, refunds, edits) is pushed to TikTok Shop, so a product that sells out on your website also sells out on TikTok.
  • Matched by SKU. Products are matched by SKU, ignoring upper and lower case. If a TikTok SKU isn’t found in WooCommerce, the order is still imported and a clear note explains what to fix.
  • See what happened. Every import, stock update and error is logged in WooCommerce → Status → Logs.

Ordersmith is an independent plugin by SysRidge. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by TikTok or WooCommerce; TikTok, TikTok Shop and WooCommerce are trademarks of their respective owners.

Free, with no product limits. Connect your TikTok Shop with unlimited products and orders.

Ordersmith Pro is an optional add-on, sold separately: connect more than one TikTok Shop (for example a second brand), arrange shipments and print labels in bulk, get email alerts, cancel and refund TikTok Shop orders from WooCommerce, and send prices, titles and descriptions to TikTok Shop. Everything listed above works without it. See Ordersmith Pro

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or newer (HPOS compatible)
  • A TikTok Shop seller account in a supported market (currently the United Kingdom)
  • Products that use the same SKU in WooCommerce and TikTok Shop

External services

Ordersmith connects to two external services. Both are needed for it to work.

TikTok Shop Open API (by TikTok)
Used to read your orders, products, returns and refunds, arrange shipments, fetch shipping labels, send tracking numbers, and update stock levels. Requests are sent from your website directly to open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com and auth.tiktok-shops.com, but only after you connect your shop, and only with the permissions you approve. They include order IDs, SKUs, stock quantities, tracking numbers and your shop’s access token.
Terms: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/eea/terms-of-service/en
Privacy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/eea/privacy-policy/en

Ordersmith connection service (by SysRidge, hosted in Germany)
TikTok Shop requires every API request to be signed with a secret that cannot be shipped inside a public plugin, so Ordersmith uses a small SysRidge service at n8n.sysridge.com.au. It:

  • exchanges and refreshes your shop’s access token when you connect and about once a week afterwards (the token passes through and is not stored),
  • signs each API request: it receives the request path and parameters, such as order IDs, SKU quantities or tracking numbers, but never TikTok’s responses, so it never sees buyer details,
  • stores your shop ID, your site’s notification address and a per-site secret, so it can forward TikTok Shop order notifications (order ID and status only) to your site for instant sync, plus a notice if you disconnect the app in TikTok Shop. This is removed when you disconnect.

The service is contacted only after you click Connect TikTok Shop.
Terms: https://www.sysridge.com.au/ordersmith/terms/
Privacy: https://www.sysridge.com.au/privacy-policy/#ordersmith
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Ordersmith from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Ordersmith and click Connect TikTok Shop.
  3. Log in to TikTok Shop Seller Center and approve the connection.
  4. Back in WordPress, click Finish connecting.
  5. Click Send all stock to TikTok once to align stock levels.

From then on, orders and stock sync automatically.
sections.faq:
Why are some buyer addresses partly hidden (a***o)?

For orders shipped with a TikTok Shop shipping label, TikTok Shop only shares a masked address with sellers. The full address is printed on the label. This is a TikTok Shop privacy rule, not a Ordersmith limitation.

A product’s stock isn’t syncing. What should I check?

The product must have Manage stock enabled and a SKU that matches the TikTok Shop seller SKU. Upper and lower case don’t matter, but spaces and dashes do. Check WooCommerce → Status → Logs (source “ordersmith”) for details.

Do orders placed before I connected affect my stock?

No. Orders from before you connected are imported for your records only, and stock is not changed for them, because you will already have handled them.

New orders take up to an hour to appear

Instant sync needs TikTok Shop’s notifications to reach your website. If your site isn’t reachable from the internet (for example a local or password-protected staging site), Ordersmith falls back to checking every 15 minutes. The Ordersmith settings page shows which mode is active.

Are buyers emailed by WooCommerce?

No. TikTok Shop does not allow sellers to contact buyers outside TikTok, so Ordersmith imports orders without the buyer’s email address and WooCommerce sends them nothing. You still receive the usual “New order” email.

What happens if I disconnect Ordersmith in TikTok Shop Seller Center?

Syncing stops, and WordPress shows a notice with a Reconnect TikTok Shop link. Orders already imported stay in WooCommerce.

What happens when a TikTok order is cancelled or refunded?

A TikTok cancellation cancels the WooCommerce order and puts its stock back. A completed TikTok refund or return is recorded as a WooCommerce refund; returned items go back into stock, while refunds where the buyer keeps the item don’t change stock.

Cancel and refund TikTok orders in TikTok Seller Center. If you cancel a TikTok order only in WooCommerce, its stock is held until it is also cancelled on TikTok Shop, so the item can’t be sold twice. (Ordersmith Pro can cancel and refund on TikTok Shop for you, from the WooCommerce order screen.)

Can I change a buyer’s address?

No. TikTok Shop only lets the buyer change their delivery address.

Which markets are supported?

The United Kingdom. More TikTok Shop markets will be added as they are approved.

Is there a TikTok Shop sandbox or test shop I can use?

TikTok Shop doesn’t offer merchants a sandbox. Its test shops are only available to app developers. We test Ordersmith on our own UK development shop, covering authorisation, instant order notifications, stock updates, cancellations, returns/refunds and shipping.

Do I need a TikTok developer account or my own app?

No. Ordersmith uses our approved TikTok Shop app, so you just click Connect TikTok Shop in WooCommerce and approve it in Seller Center. We don’t provide separate test access, but the plugin is free, so you can test it yourself straight away.

How can I test without affecting live orders or stock?

  1. Install Ordersmith on a staging copy of your WooCommerce site.
  2. On that copy, keep only one or two test products, each with a SKU that matches a single low-stock TikTok listing. Ordersmith matches by SKU only, so TikTok products with no matching SKU on staging are never touched.
  3. Don’t click Send all stock to TikTok on staging. Change stock on the test product only and check that TikTok updates.
  4. Orders from before you connected are imported for your records only and don’t change stock.
  5. If staging isn’t reachable from the internet (for example it’s password-protected), orders arrive every 15 minutes instead of instantly. The settings page shows which mode is active.
  6. Cancellations, returns and tracking sync when a real order on the test listing goes through those steps. Each event is logged under WooCommerce → Status → Logs (source “ordersmith”).
  7. When you’re happy, disconnect staging and connect your live site.

Where is the documentation, and what are the restrictions and costs?

  • Documentation: this plugin page, FAQ and support forum, plus sysridge.com.au/ordersmith.
  • Restrictions: UK TikTok Shops only for now, with WooCommerce 8.0+, and SKUs must match exactly (case doesn’t matter, but spaces and dashes do). TikTok doesn’t share buyer email addresses, so WooCommerce won’t email TikTok buyers.
  • Cost: the plugin is free, with no product or order limits. Ordersmith Pro is an optional paid add-on (multiple shops, bulk labels, email alerts, cancel/refund from WooCommerce).
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release: instant order import, status updates, TikTok Shop labels and shipment arrangement, seller-shipped tracking, stock sync by SKU.
  • Cancellations, refunds and returns sync to WooCommerce, with stock restored where the item comes back.
  • Reconnect notice when the app is disconnected in TikTok Shop.
  • Automatic retry when TikTok Shop is busy (rate limits).
